# Cross-country bond relative value

Universe: US, CA, GB, DE, JP, AU, NZ, SE, CH, NO (10 markets).  Signals formed at month-end, traded at the next month's average price, held one month.  Evaluation 1980-01 – 2026-07.  Local excess returns of 10-year par bonds (currency-hedged under covered interest parity), long-short, risk-scaled.

Placebo p: share of 1,000 random cross-country rankings with an equal or higher Sharpe ratio.

## Multiple-testing correction across the six signals

Hansen SPA test of the null that no signal has a positive mean return (stationary bootstrap, mean block 12 months, 2,000 draws):

- from 1980: consistent p = 0.109, Reality Check p = 0.109 (best signal: carry)
- from 1990: consistent p = 0.007, Reality Check p = 0.010 (best signal: carry)
